source.note: Kenney police (FBX, not the plan's GLB: the GLB references Textures/colormap.png, as for car-sedan and car-sports-sedan from the same kit and pin). Kenney's black-and-white layout (dark bonnet, boot and waistline, light doors and roof) is kept in noon ink and paper, light bar in the accent red. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
